prereg.question: Of a retained steered state's effect on a later choice, how much travels as changed stored content and how much as changed addressing, and does that split shift when the same total push is spread over six sightings instead of one?
prereg.estimand: the strength-ladder run estimand, unchanged: the differenced forced choice margin regressed on the NOMINAL signed dose over five points, session-cluster bootstrap. Each condition is differenced against its own dose-0 read (native for the FULL condition, split-path for every spliced condition), so a path offset cannot enter a slope.

channels.addressing: slope of the (steered keys, clean values) memory
channels.storage: slope of the (clean keys, steered values) memory
channels.shares: each channel slope as a fraction of the full_split slope, paired bootstrap

reading.UNDEFINED: the full cell's own slope interval includes zero: no effect to split
reading.STORAGE_DOMINATES: storage minus addressing is positive and its interval excludes 0
reading.ADDRESSING_DOMINATES: storage minus addressing is negative and excludes 0
reading.BOTH_CONTRIBUTE: the difference includes 0 and each half's own slope excludes 0 with the sign of the full effect
reading.NEITHER_RESOLVED: the difference includes 0 and at least one half is not distinguishable from zero: the run does not resolve the split

consistency.additivity: slope(addressing) + slope(storage) - slope(full_split), paired CI. Zero if the two halves carve the effect cleanly; this residual IS the note's K-by-V interaction term.
consistency.opposition: slope(opposed) - (slope(addressing) - slope(storage)), paired CI. Zero if the storage channel is odd in the dose, which is what makes the opposed condition a competition rather than a third thing.
consistency.if_both_fail: the split does not describe the mechanism; report that, and do NOT report channel shares as if they were weights

prereg.extension: storage's share at six sightings minus its share at one, paired on shared skeletons. Addressing's share GROWING when the push is spread thinner supports the account that adding perturbed positions redistributes attention rather than adding to it, which is why the strength-ladder run found spreading costs. Storage's share holding constant refutes it and leaves the strength-ladder run depth result unexplained by this decomposition.

gates.below_injection_identity: the steered and clean prefix caches must be bit-identical for every decoder layer at or below the injection layer, on every session. Predicted by construction; a failure means the harness does not do what we think and the run stops.
gates.full_reproduction: the FULL condition must return the strength-ladder run recorded slope within 5%. Same computation, same seeds: this checks the plumbing.
gates.source_fidelity: the fidelity run cache-fidelity criterion applies to each CONTRIBUTING pass against its own recorded logits, in the FULL condition, exactly as the strength-ladder run. A hybrid memory has no recorded reference and is not gated that way.

prereg.scope_limit: A memory whose addressing and storage come from different passes is one no forward pass would produce. That is legitimate as a causal decomposition and is exactly what the algebra describes, but the claim it supports is which component CARRIES the effect, not that such a state arises naturally. Because the push is injected at a single layer, both halves above that layer are downstream of one perturbation rather than two independent stores, so 'storage dominates' means the influence travels as changed content, not that steering wrote a payload into storage as a separate act.

full.note: the strength-ladder run read path, unmodified: one prefill of the whole stream

full_split.note: the same memory, reassembled through the splice path; the reference every spliced condition is differenced against

addressing.note: steered keys over clean values: the salience route

storage.note: clean keys over steered values: the valenced-payload route

opposed.note: addressing says one zone, storage says the other; the sign names the winner

rows_full.note: the note's ideal stitch: clean everywhere but the injected rows

spread_verdict.note: the redistribution account of the strength-ladder run depth advantage predicts addressing's share growing when the push is spread. A split panel means this decomposition does not explain that depth advantage panel-wide: it is consistent with the account in some models and points the other way in others

e1_k1.label: one sighting, full strength

reproduction_267.note: the same deterministic computation on the same seeds under the same cache-fidelity gate, so this checks the new plumbing rather than testing for drift

path_control.note: full_split minus full: the same memory read through the splice path. Any non-zero here is numerical, and every spliced condition is differenced against full_split so it cannot enter a channel slope

consistency.note: additivity is addressing + storage - full_split, which IS the note's K-by-V interaction term; opposition is opposed - (addressing - storage). If both intervals exclude zero the split does not describe the mechanism and the shares are descriptive numbers, not channel weights

scope_coincidence.note: fraction of spliced reads where the rows scope returned exactly the all-scope value. Near 1 means no cached position follows the injected span, so the ideal-stitch reading is a construction identity and is withheld for this cell

ideal_stitch.note: the note's ideal stitch: a clean cache everywhere except the injected rows. Where the two scopes separate, share_rows_full says how much of the effect the injected rows carry by themselves, with everything they propagated into later positions removed. Where they coincide -- no cached position follows the injected span -- that reading is a construction identity and is withheld. These conditions carry NO random-direction floor.

rows_full.note: this condition carries no random-direction floor

rows_addressing.note: this condition carries no random-direction floor

rows_storage.note: this condition carries no random-direction floor

opposed_sign_detail.note: which half wins when the two are set against each other. Reported only when the opposed slope excludes zero AND clears its random-direction floor; otherwise 'unresolved'. This is a corroborating read, not an input to the pre-registered verdict rule, which is decided by the storage-minus-addressing contrast

e1_k1.floor_note: the full condition is screened against all 24 frozen random directions (best attainable rank-p 0.04); the spliced all-scope conditions against 8 of them (best attainable rank-p 0.1111); the rows-scope conditions carry no floor at all

committed_choice.note: co-primary, on the four all-scope conditions at full dose only; the margin slope above is the pre-registered estimand

dose_profile.note: mean of margin(dose) - margin(0) over sessions, session-cluster bootstrap; identically zero at dose 0 by construction

arrival.note: the first lever run forced self-report margin, read downstream of the injection in the FULL condition exactly as the strength-ladder run
